description.en: Small sessile-leaved floating rosettes are linked by stolons and bear roots below.
description.zh: 小型无柄叶浮生莲座由匍匐茎相连，下方具根。

scientific_scope.en: Conservative whole-organism reconstruction concept for Limnobiophyllum pedunculatum; cited fossils support gross structures, while unpreserved proportions and colour remain artistic choices.
scientific_scope.zh: Limnobiophyllum pedunculatum 的保守整株重建概念；所引化石支持主要结构，未保存比例和颜色仍属美术选择。

distinctness.en: Sessile heart-based blades and stolon connections differ from Cobbania's trumpet-like petiolate leaves.
distinctness.zh: 无柄心形基叶片及匍匐茎连接区别于Cobbania喇叭状有柄叶。

modeling_brief.en: Build a branching stolon with a few distinct rosettes and simple hanging root bundles; spacing is compositional.
modeling_brief.zh: 建立分枝匍匐茎、少量清楚叶丛和简化垂根束；间距为构图选择。

uncertainty: Soft-tissue inflation and floating posture are inferred; genus diversity is not split into size variants.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.
